pillar_reactions.evidence: Delivered in full — two programmes, kettlebell three to four times a week at 30 minutes, mobility five to ten minutes before bed, plus the weekly form-video review loop with Trevor. Prospect gave only minimal assent to 'Is that making sense so far?' — 'Yeah.' No questions asked and no tie-back to his own goal despite the rep explicitly hooking it to the bulging disc.

Presented as 'optimizing instead of overhauling' with the whole-foods and cheat-day framing. No reaction recorded from the prospect at all — he had already volunteered his sugar cut earlier and the rep did not connect the two.

Rep tied it back to the Muay Thai coach who pushed him. Prospect's response to the full three-pillar block was flat agreement: 'It's doable. I mean, I don't see anything wrong with it. It sounds like pretty straightforward.' Agreement without engagement — notably he did not light up even though he had told the rep 'if I don't get challenged, I get bored.'

anchors.raw: Yeah, exactly. But four grand, that's a vacation.
anchors.note: He priced the programme against a family holiday rather than against coaching. The rep answered with 'what's more important than your health?' instead of getting the number into a financial-picture conversation.

anchors.raw: Well, I mean, that sounds pretty good, but I didn't think the program was only $4,000.
anchors.note: He arrived expecting a materially lower number. Nothing earlier in the call had pre-framed price, and the setter notes were never read back, so the figure landed cold.

anchors.raw: ChatGPT ain't doing any no good. I could talk to ChatGPT, but they don't know my body's structural. They have no idea what I can or cannot do.
anchors.note: He had already tried and rejected the free option and articulated exactly why it fails — no knowledge of his body, no form feedback. This was live ammunition for the value case and the rep never used it.

unmet_demand.want: A low-risk way to see what the programme actually is before committing thousands of dollars — 'I wouldn't know exactly what this program offers me to actually try it'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The sanctioned offer has no trial, no pilot, no sample block and no demo asset, and the rep had nothing concrete to show on the call. He filled the hole by inventing a paid one-month trial at $1,200.

unmet_demand.want: Structural relief for a 26-year L3/L4 bulging disc impinging the sciatic nerve, as an alternative to the fusion surgery his doctors are recommending
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The programme is unsupervised remote kettlebell and mobility coaching with weekly video review, not clinically supervised rehabilitation, and no clinician clearance was sought. Whether it can serve a diagnosed disc pathology is an open clinical question, not a marketing one — but the rep asserted it would 'address the root cause' and 'clear any injuries'.

unmet_demand.want: Hands-on, in-person style correction of his lifting technique — 'it's not the same as getting it from an actual one-on-one'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Delivery is asynchronous video review on a weekly loop, not live one-to-one coaching. The rep described the loop accurately but never addressed the gap against the in-person standard the prospect had set from seven years with a live Muay Thai coach.
